en.headline: DFI Retail puts Peak shopping centre up for tender
en.dek: CBRE, the sole agent, said the Dairy Farm Guildford Road Shopping Centre tender closes at noon on 19 November.
body: DFI Retail, the food and beverage arm of Jardine Matheson, is offering the commercial portion of the Dairy Farm Guildford Road Shopping Centre on The Peak for sale by public tender, the South China Morning Post reported.

Sole agent CBRE said the tender closes at noon on 19 November. The mall is a two-storey retail podium with a gross floor area of about 8,974 square feet, together with car-parking spaces, and sits near the Peak campus of the German Swiss International School.
The shopping centre is fully leased, with tenants including a Wellcome supermarket, estate agencies and a cafe, the report said. DFI Retail is the operator behind the Wellcome chain.
The paper did not state an asking price. The sale is of the entire commercial portion of the centre.

zh.headline: 牛奶公司山頂商場公開招標出售
zh.dek: 獨家代理世邦魏理仕表示，山頂僑福道牛奶公司購物中心招標於11月19日中午截止。
body: 《南華早報》報道，怡和集團旗下食品及飲品業務DFI Retail，正以公開招標形式出售山頂僑福道牛奶公司購物中心的商業部分。
獨家代理世邦魏理仕表示，招標於11月19日中午截止。商場為兩層零售平台，總樓面面積綄8974平方呎，連同多個車位，鄰近德瑞國際學校山頂校舍。
報道指商場目前全數出租，租戶包括惠康超級市場、地產代理及一間咖啡店。DFI Retail是惠康的營運方。
報道沒有列出叫價。今次出售的是購物中心全部商業部分。
